title: Generative AI Acceptable Use Standard
owner_role: Office of the CIO - AI Governance Lead
source_doc: FICTIONAL: Example State University Policy Manual, chapter 18.4
scope_note: Applies to all staff use of generative AI in the course of University work. Silent on student-employee supervision.

title: Institutional Data Classification and Handling Standard
source_doc: FICTIONAL: Example State University Policy Manual, chapter 11.2
scope_note: Predates institutional AI use. Defines data classes and handling duties for storage and transmission; does not name prompt text or retrieval context.

title: AI Tool Procurement and Vendor Review Procedure
owner_role: Procurement Services with Information Security Office
source_doc: FICTIONAL: Example State University Procurement Procedure AI-02
scope_note: Requires security, privacy, and accessibility review before a new AI product is licensed. Ambiguous about AI features added to products already under contract.

title: Secure Development Lifecycle Standard
source_doc: FICTIONAL: Example State University Security Standard SEC-07
scope_note: Requires named human review of every change, approval of record for every release, and defined retention for application logs.

title: AI Output Review and Accountability Guideline
source_doc: FICTIONAL: draft circulated 2026-06-20, not ratified as of assessment window
scope_note: Draft. Would require the human who accepts AI output to record what they verified. Not in force; binds nothing today.
